inventory = json.loads((source_folder / "inventory.json").read_text())["files"]
    source_check = call(
        "tracked-source-after-tests",
        ["xargs", "-0", "sha256sum", "--"],
        data=b"".join(("/workspace/repository/" + path).encode() + b"\0" for path in inventory),
        timeout=180,
        allow_failure=True,
    )
    changed = []
    observed_files = set()
    for line in source_check["stdout"].splitlines():
        digest, path = line.split("  ", 1)
        path = path.removeprefix("/workspace/repository/")
        observed_files.add(path)
        if inventory.get(path) != digest:
            changed.append(path)
    changed += sorted(set(inventory) - observed_files)
    result["changedTrackedFiles"] = changed
    result["trackedSourceIntact"] = source_check["exitCode"] == 0 and not changed
    if spec["kind"] == "go":

spans.claim: Historical capture receipt includes argv, timeout, byte/hash output and elapsed fields; default16MiB.
spans.excerpt:
def command(folder, label, argv, *, data=b"", timeout=60, limit=16 * 1024**2):
    output = folder / "logs" / label
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    started_at, start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), time.monotonic()
    result = limited_process(argv, data=data, timeout=timeout, output_limit=limit)
    (output / "stdout.txt").write_text(result["stdout"])
    (output / "stderr.txt").write_text(result["stderr"])
    receipt = {
        "argv": argv,
        "startedAt": started_at,
        "elapsedSeconds": time.monotonic() - start,
        "exitCode": result["exitCode"],
        "error": result["error"],
        "stdinBytes": len(data),
        "stdinSha256": sha(data),
        "stdoutSha256": sha(result["stdout"].encode()),
        "stderrSha256": sha(result["stderr"].encode()),
        "costUsd": None,
        "costExclusions": ["No metered container/host charge source."],
    }
    write(output / "receipt.json", receipt)
    return result
